question: I’m in the mood for breakfast, but don’t feel like traveling far out of Rose Park. What do you recommend? I don’t like sweet breakfasts.
output_text:
Here's a shortlist of **savory, non-sweet breakfast spots close to Rose Park** (all within ~2.7 miles), pulled from the map/evidence search rather than a sweets-heavy bakery lineup:

| Spot | Distance | Rating | Reviews | Why it fits "not sweet" |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Our Kitchen Café** – 985 N Redwood Rd, North SLC | 1.76 mi | 4.7 | 375 | Classic diner-style breakfast (eggs, hash, omelets) — closest and highest-rated option |
| **Dee's Family Restaurant** – 2085 S Redwood Rd | 1.75 mi | 4.3 | 1,808 | Old-school American diner, huge review base, savory comfort-food breakfast |
| **Somali Restaurant (Horn of Africa)** – Swaner Rd | 1.99 mi | 4.6 | 288 | Savory East African breakfast fare (sambusa, spiced meats) — a change of pace from typical pancakes |
| **Apollo Burger** – 950 W 1700 S | 1.67 mi | 4.3 | 835 | Fast, savory breakfast sandwiches, very close |
| **Tacos Garay** – 909 300 W | 2.36 mi | 4.5 | 208 | Savory Mexican breakfast (huevos, tacos) |
| **Vertical Diner** – 234 W 900 S | 2.45 mi | 4.4 | 2,158 | Savory vegan diner scrambles/hash, big review count |
| **Roula's Cafe** – 351 S W Temple | 2.66 mi | 4.3 | 38 | Mediterranean-style savory breakfast |

I deliberately left off the sweet-leaning places the search surfaced nearby — **Johnny Kolache, The Amsterdam Bakery Market Cafe, Eva's Bakery, and Bruges Belgian Bistro** (waffles) — since you said you're not in the mood for sweet.

**My top pick:** Our Kitchen Café — closest at 1.76 mi, highest rating (4.7) among the savory options, and a solid 375 reviews. Dee's Family Restaurant is a strong runner-up if you want a bigger, more tested menu (1,808 reviews) at essentially the same distance.

One caveat: none of these have a matched SLCHD inspection record in the database (no `slchd_establishment_key`), which is typical — **98.4% of establishments in this dataset have no inspection match** — so I can't show you a health-inspection history for any of them; this is purely a ratings/distance recommendation.

messages.content:
Here's a shortlist of **savory, non-sweet breakfast spots close to Rose Park** (all within ~2.7 miles), pulled from the map/evidence search rather than a sweets-heavy bakery lineup:

| Spot | Distance | Rating | Reviews | Why it fits "not sweet" |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Our Kitchen Café** – 985 N Redwood Rd, North SLC | 1.76 mi | 4.7 | 375 | Classic diner-style breakfast (eggs, hash, omelets) — closest and highest-rated option |
| **Dee's Family Restaurant** – 2085 S Redwood Rd | 1.75 mi | 4.3 | 1,808 | Old-school American diner, huge review base, savory comfort-food breakfast |
| **Somali Restaurant (Horn of Africa)** – Swaner Rd | 1.99 mi | 4.6 | 288 | Savory East African breakfast fare (sambusa, spiced meats) — a change of pace from typical pancakes |
| **Apollo Burger** – 950 W 1700 S | 1.67 mi | 4.3 | 835 | Fast, savory breakfast sandwiches, very close |
| **Tacos Garay** – 909 300 W | 2.36 mi | 4.5 | 208 | Savory Mexican breakfast (huevos, tacos) |
| **Vertical Diner** – 234 W 900 S | 2.45 mi | 4.4 | 2,158 | Savory vegan diner scrambles/hash, big review count |
| **Roula's Cafe** – 351 S W Temple | 2.66 mi | 4.3 | 38 | Mediterranean-style savory breakfast |

I deliberately left off the sweet-leaning places the search surfaced nearby — **Johnny Kolache, The Amsterdam Bakery Market Cafe, Eva's Bakery, and Bruges Belgian Bistro** (waffles) — since you said you're not in the mood for sweet.

**My top pick:** Our Kitchen Café — closest at 1.76 mi, highest rating (4.7) among the savory options, and a solid 375 reviews. Dee's Family Restaurant is a strong runner-up if you want a bigger, more tested menu (1,808 reviews) at essentially the same distance.

One caveat: none of these have a matched SLCHD inspection record in the database (no `slchd_establishment_key`), which is typical — **98.4% of establishments in this dataset have no inspection match** — so I can't show you a health-inspection history for any of them; this is purely a ratings/distance recommendation.
